original.prompt: Consider the following statements about India's ship-recycling performance in 2025, as reported in June 2026:
items: India's share of global ship-recycling tonnage rose to 35.4% from 30.1% in 2024.
India's ship-recycling volumes rose nearly 60% to about 9 million gross tons.
The result met the Maritime India Vision 2030 goal of leading the world in ship recycling five years ahead of schedule.
original.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
original.explain: Statement 2 is wrong: volumes rose nearly 60% to 2.99 million gross tons, while 9 million light displacement tons is the planned annual capacity target for Alang. The figures were attributed by the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways to UNCTAD, and India overtook long-time leader Bangladesh.
original.source: India's share rose to 35.4% from 30.1% in 2024, with volumes up nearly 60% to 2.99 million gross tons
